SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.nickname as nickname,
a.album_id as albumId, a.title as title, a.created_at as albumCreatedAt, a.album_image_URL as albumImageURL;
p.playlist_id as playlistId, p.latitude as latitude, p.longitude as longitude, p.location_address as locationAddress,
m.track_name as trackName, m.artist_name as artistName,
ph.photo_id as photoId, ph.photo_URL as photoURL, ph.created_at as photoCreatedAt FROM user u LEFT JOIN album a ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND a.status = true LEFT JOIN playlist p ON a.album_id = p.album_id LEFT JOIN music m ON p.music_id = m.music_id RIGHT JOIN photo ph ON p.playlist_id = ph.playlist_id -- 파생 테이블을 사용하여 최신 앨범 3개의 album_id를 가져온다. LEFT JOIN ( SELECT album_id FROM album WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3 ) recentAlbums ON a.album_id = recentAlbums.album_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND (a.album_id IS NULL OR recentAlbums.album_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT user.user_id as userId, user.nickname as nickname, user.profile_image_URL as profileImageURL, user.introduce as introduce, (CASE WHEN #{loginUserId} = user.user_id THEN false WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow WHERE following_id = #{loginUserId} AND followed_id = user.user_id ) THEN true ELSE false END) as followsStatus, (SELECT Count(*) FROM follow WHERE follow.followed_id = user.user_id) as followingCnt, (SELECT Count(*) FROM follow WHERE follow.following_id = user.user_id) as followedCnt, album.album_id as albumId, album.title as title, album.created_at as createdAt, album.album_image_URL as albumImageURL
FROM user LEFT JOIN album ON user.user_id = album.user_id AND album.status = true WHERE user.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY album.created_at DESC
